profile: graph neural network: A graph neural network (GNN) is used for graph-based learning and prediction tasks. The graph convolutional network (GCN) is a GNN model. GCN layers perform graph-based aggregation, a GNN hallmark, to compute node embeddings. Each GCN layer is permutation invariant. GCNs support deep, sequential node representation learning.
